NEW: 🟠 An AI security scanner finds a Bitcoin Core bug that lets one crafted message freeze a node for more than 12 seconds. Project Loupe, built by Elias Rohrer at Block's Spiral, shows that duplicate orphan announcements force a node to repeat the same expensive check thousands of times. The fix ships in Bitcoin Core 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1. The 29.x branch gets no patch, so anyone still running it needs to upgrade. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2124933365497241749
